snippet.title: An Easter to Remember - Teaser | WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM!
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4119160/An_Easter_to_Remember/

AFTER TODAY, YOU’RE NEVER GOING TO FORGET THIS EASTER...
BREAKING NEWS: A man in a rabbit costume has broken into a local middle school and is attacking students, teachers, and staff with a chainsaw. Authorities have surrounded the building and are attempting to enter without risking further casualties.

You play as one of the kids trapped inside during the lockdown. The front doors are barricaded, so your only options are escape or death. Stay quiet and move carefully, watch every corner as a direct encounter with the killer could mean certain death… or worse.

CAN YOU SURVIVE LONG ENOUGH TO ESCAPE?

- Short, intense, and terrifying experience: Fear and tension are guaranteed from start to finish. There’s never a moment of rest — it’s a race against time.
- Completely defenseless: Run, hide, or die — those are your only options.
- You’ll never know what to expect: The Killer Rabbit is cunning — he’ll always find a way to catch you by surprise when you least expect it.
- Replayability to keep you coming back: Items always spawn in different locations, and events never happen in the same order. It’s the Killer Rabbit who decides your fate.
- Multiplayer to share the scares with your friends: You and your friends can play as the children trying to escape, or become the Killer Rabbit to hunt them down.

An Easter to Remember is a terrifying Easter Horror Game where you play as a student trapped in a local middle school and avoid a chainsaw-wielding maniac in an Easter Bunny suit. Check out my other Games: https://williamjacobproductions.com/
